title: Enabling AWS Cloud FPGA Development Using High-Level Vitis HLS
abstract: arXiv:2611.06829v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a toolchain for development of ML models on AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure from high-level language, implementing a complete Vitis HLS to HDK bridge to AFI workflow that has been absent from the academic literature despite eight years of AWS FPGA availability. We introduce a four-level methodology (FP32 PyTorch, bit-accurate quantized Python, HLS C-simulation, physical FPGA) to aid in localizing errors, including FPGA-specific circuit errors. Together these tools allow coding agents to effectively implement FPGA designs from user directions, testing and debugging as needed. We document the deployment workflow, timing closure strategies, and practical HLS engineering decisions that proved crucial. We validate using TinyBERT fine-tuned for address Named Entity Recognition, implementing the embedding layer and the first of four encoder layers on the FPGA hardware. translated_title: 使用高级Vitis HLS实现AWS云FPGA开发
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一套在AWS EC2 F2云FPGA基础设施上使用高级语言开发机器学习模型的工具链，实现了一个完整的从Vitis HLS到HDK桥接再到AFI的工作流程——尽管AWS FPGA已面世八年，这一流程在学术文献中始终缺失。我们引入了一种四级方法论（FP32 PyTorch、位精确量化Python、HLS C仿真、物理FPGA），以帮助定位错误，包括FPGA特有的电路错误。这些工具共同使编码智能体能够根据用户指令有效地实现FPGA设计，并按需进行测试和调试。我们记录了部署工作流程、时序收敛策略以及被证明至关重要的实用HLS工程决策。我们使用针对命名实体识别任务微调的TinyBERT进行验证，在FPGA硬件上实现了嵌入层和四个编码器层中的第一层。我们的实现从主机DRAM流式传输权重。
tldr: 该论文提出了一套完整的从Vitis HLS到AWS云FPGA部署的工具链和四级误差定位方法论，使开发者乃至AI编码智能体能够通过高级语言在AWS云FPGA上高效开发、测试和部署机器学习模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a complete toolchain and four-level error-localization methodology enabling high-level Vitis HLS-based ML development and deployment on AWS cloud FPGAs, empowering both developers and AI coding agents to efficiently implement FPGA designs.
